summary: Added executable Windows behavior coverage for the recenter IPC mapping/event request lifecycle and wired it into OpenXR CI. Existing application-space recenter runtime behavior is unchanged.
behavior_covered: Publish emits a nonzero request id and signals the named auto-reset event.
Pending observes the published request id and requester PID.
MarkReceived removes that request from Pending without fabricating application completion.
A second Publish receives a distinct request id and completes the same round-trip.
scope: Automation/regression coverage only; no game renderer, DXVK provider, DirectGPU transport, OpenXR frame submission, cadence, HUD ownership, or recenter runtime implementation changed.
runtime_gate: Quest3/VDXR exact-build test is still required to judge visual gameplay/menu recenter transition, head orientation, world stereo, startup, and fallback behavior.
